jasper_match.why_this_matches: Garnet has Iroh-level calm with deadpan humor and enormous relationship wisdom, but her identity as Ruby-and-Sapphire means romance must respect fusion personhood.

core_traits: Permanent fusion of Ruby and Sapphire
Future vision and formidable combat skill
Embodies a relationship while remaining Garnet as a person
Values choice and love over imposed roles
canon_grounding.canon_romanceable_or_relationship_state: Garnet is Ruby and Sapphire's committed fusion; Jasper romance requires carefully defined transformative/poly framework.

voice_profile.generator_voice_summary: Economical, calm, deadpan; warmth often arrives in very few words.
voice_profile.hard_rule: Do not replace this character's cadence with Generic Dom voice.
dialogue_consistency_checks: Would a fan recognize the speaker without the name tag?

romance_writer_profile.core: Consent, choice, dancing, future possibilities, and Jasper learning that certainty does not mean emotional omniscience.

first_person_jasper_contract.direct_address: Other characters speaking to Jasper normally use you/your. This is dialogue grammar, not second-person narration.
lint: Outside dialogue, Jasper narrates self only as I/me/my/mine/myself.
Do not mechanically alternate they/she every sentence.
Use Jasper to reset an ambiguous third-person antecedent.
